## What and why

What does this change do, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New tool / feature
- [ ] Refactor / internal
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` is clean (zero errors, zero warnings)
- [ ] `npm run test:ci` passes
- [ ] Device-dependent suites run locally if device behavior changed
- [ ] New/changed shell interpolation goes through `shellQuote()`
- [ ] New `z.number()` params have `.min()/.max()`; params have `.describe()`
- [ ] README tool list updated (for new/renamed tools)
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated (for user-visible changes)
